---
title: "The cran-comments.md template already announces a note"
ref: PKG-09
categories: [Packages]
impact: incoherent
attendu: "a neutral template, to fill in with the actual check results"
versions: "All recent versions of {usethis}"
source: "Slack ThinkR (2024)"
---

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
usethis::use_cran_comments()
```

```text
## R CMD check results

0 errors | 0 warnings | 1 note

* This is a new release.
```
:::

This pitfall depends on a package's files and on {usethis}, so it cannot be replayed in the browser.

## Why

The template starts from the most common case, a first submission: CRAN then always reports a "New submission" note. The file comes pre-filled with that note, and nothing reminds you to correct it.

For an update with no note at all, or with two notes, the file sent to CRAN describes a check that is not yours. The reviewers read it, and an inconsistency like this can cost a round trip.

## The fix

Rerun the check, then rewrite the summary with the actual figures and explain every remaining note.

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```text
## R CMD check results

0 errors | 0 warnings | 0 notes

* This is a minor update fixing a bug in summarise_data().
```
:::
